findings.title: Anatomy and bodily condition
findings.claim: The focus display can be read as an outwardly assessed bodily condition: an internal organ, a rear flank, and nutritive fat make the visible person legible as a whole condition.
findings.mechanism: The focus form carries the supplied lung facet, while the prayer-form context carries the rear flank and the food context carries animal fatness. Their contact turns seeing into an inspection of external form, vital interior, and nourishment together.
findings.reader_payoff: The displayed identity becomes a condition that can be read through bodily signs rather than a merely abstract public pose.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains people who show off. This is a bounded bodily image from the supplied pericope, not a claim that the verb lexically means lung or that the whole surah is an animal allegory.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and all three branch carriers are supplied, but the synthesis remains a contextual authoring relation.

findings.reader_payoff: Showing becomes an action organized by an inner decision process, so the reader can see agency behind the public surface.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains ostentatious display. The deliberative sequence is a local contextual image and does not claim that the Form III verb means deliberation here.

epistemic.reason: The supplied channel evidence gives exact focus and context carriers with a coherent self-governance mechanism; the authorial synthesis remains contextual.
